content: #1 It used to be the case that when viewing a discussion to which new comments had been posted since the page was loaded, a popup box would appear in the lower left saying “n new comments”, and clicking on that link would reload the page to show the new comments. I kind of liked that feature, but it seems to have stopped recently. Would it be easy to get it back?
subject: new comments popups
